tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: THE single accent of a video. Alias it to another hue only when a brand variant is approved; everything accent-coloured follows it.

tokens.name: blue-600
tokens.usage: Cobalt reference blue: full-bleed blue scenes, painted figures, accent lines, serif emphasis on paper, highlight boxes. Measured from reference reels.

tokens.name: blue-400
tokens.usage: Glows, halos, orbs and the graph ball on dark grounds. Never for text on paper.

tokens.name: blue-200
tokens.usage: Soft halo tint behind center illustrations on paper.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: White paper ground for line, center, side, object and text-centric scenes. Always with grain.

tokens.name: paper-shade
tokens.usage: Rough-paper mottling and dot grid on the paper ground.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Black ground for line scenes; body ink on paper.

tokens.name: graph-ground
tokens.usage: Graph and statistics scenes, with noise and the grid.

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: Thin glowing grid lines on graph-ground.

tokens.name: caption-white
tokens.usage: Captions on A-roll, B-roll, paintings, blue and dark scenes.

tokens.name: caption-ink
tokens.usage: Sans captions on paper. Serif emphasis on paper uses accent.

tokens.name: aroll-fade
tokens.usage: Bottom gradient over A-roll so white captions read.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background of this design-system site and previews.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards on surface.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Documentation text on surface.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary documentation text on surface; 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers in documentation.

styles.name: hero-sans
styles.usage: Hero words inside full-screen graphic scenes only (concrete nouns, numbers). Never on A-roll captions [R1.1].

styles.name: hero-serif
styles.usage: Every A-roll caption hero, lowercase, even plain words like 'not' [R1.1]; emotion and abstraction in graphics. On paper: accent colour. Revealed character by character (M02).

styles.name: support
styles.usage: Remaining words of the group, about 36% of hero size, tucked tight to a hero corner; revealed word by word, rising from below (M01) [R1.1]. Was 32px.

styles.name: support-serif
styles.usage: Occasional soft lead-in inside a serif-led group.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Text-centric key phrase between quote marks.

styles.name: scene-title
styles.usage: Title word above a center illustration or graph.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Callout labels, graph annotations, leader-line text.

styles.name: label-caps
styles.usage: Graph reference lines and axis names.

tokens.name: safe-x
tokens.usage: Left/right edge of the Instagram Reels safe zone at 1080 wide: content stays within x 120-960 [R1.1].

tokens.name: safe-top
tokens.usage: Keep everything below y 250 (Reels top UI) [R1.1].

tokens.name: safe-bottom
tokens.usage: Keep everything above y 1600, i.e. 320px from the bottom (Reels caption and UI) [R1.1].

tokens.name: safe-icon-x
tokens.usage: Below y 1130, keep content left of x 845: the Reels like/comment/share column [R1.1].

tokens.name: hero-max-width
tokens.usage: Widest a caption hero may run, so the italic overhang stays inside the safe zone [R1.1].

tokens.name: caption-y
tokens.usage: Vertical centre of the hero word on A-roll (55-70% band).

tokens.name: tuck
tokens.usage: Gap between support text and the hero: line above sits 0.8 x hero size + 8px above the hero baseline.

tokens.name: block-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between text block and illustration.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Scenes, highlight boxes, grounds: the style is square.

tokens.name: radius-photo
tokens.usage: Photo and object callout prints.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Marker dots, graph ball, orbs, halos.

tokens.name: line-paper
tokens.usage: Accent line on paper scenes (thick, round caps).

tokens.name: line-dark
tokens.usage: Accent line on black scenes, with a white marker dot.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Graph grid lines.

tokens.name: leader
tokens.usage: Thin leader line from a label to its subject.

tokens.name: grain-light
tokens.usage: Light paper overlay on B-roll and paintings. CSS opacity; in Tesseract use grain amount 0.8 on light grounds, 1.0 on dark, or it doesn't show [R1.1].

tokens.name: grain-rough
tokens.usage: Rough paper on text-centric and center scenes. CSS opacity; in Tesseract use grain amount 0.8 on light grounds, 1.0 on dark, or it doesn't show [R1.1].

tokens.name: paint
tokens.usage: Paint texture on paintings; moves with the image. Halved after the tutorial's revision.

tokens.name: noise-dark
tokens.usage: Noise on graph and black grounds. CSS opacity; in Tesseract use grain amount 0.8 on light grounds, 1.0 on dark, or it doesn't show [R1.1].

tokens.name: vignette
tokens.usage: Edge darkening on B-roll and paintings.
